payload.body: hv TO ic DIRECTLY, first-hand in ic's session, read by 09:21Z on ic's date -u, for you to record: "Please sync with VC (if you haven't already done so). Then bank, fold, and hold." ic's answer to your 09:19Z note on hv decision 64 is section 13 of the census, in short. (1) RE-MINT ON THE SHOWN FORM: with 16 stored hex two records can share their shown 7 (or 4 in a thread), and git no longer reports it because they are different files. So a mint re-mints when its shown form is already visible in the clone. A clash across branches is a doctor finding, repaired by remint, which keeps 'fixed' with no lengthening rule. (2) MARKER: ic withdraws bare issue ids. cc's evidence is mechanical (intentfiles.rs:38-42, organize's view detection), and a marker serves the human labelling too. The letters: issue I plus hex, uppercase like ST, shown I4f9a2c1. A work package takes no letter, since it never stands alone. (3) MISSED until now: contract.rs:269-283 threads_named scans a criterion or test line for ST plus four digits with its own pattern (issue 0299's borrowed-id refusal). It is a free-text thread scanner outside the waist and must ask the waist. legacy.rs:3365 is v2-only and can stay. (4) Criteria caller-assigned: noted, and section 9 is superseded. A door taking AC-9d3f.1 resolves the group prefix inside its thread. (5) R10: no transcript or golden ic owns needs a pinned id on the shipped binary. Next, on hv's word: ic banks the census at refs/bank/ic/st0095/census, folds, and holds.
